```{r}
library(pacman)
dir.create("Results/Descriptives", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
p_load(tidyverse, tidylog, gtsummary, gt, officer, colorspace, tidyr, readr, scales, stringr, ggrepel)

gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_compact()
```

```{r}
# Load data
df_all <- read_csv("Data/merged_data_all.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) 

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    hcv = replace_na(hcv, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Use the inclusion/exclusion flow flags from 01_merge_data when available
    included = if ("included_step1" %in% names(.)) coalesce(included_step1, FALSE) & !is.na(age) else (hcv == 1) & !is.na(fsm) & !is.na(age),
    cohort = if_else(included, "Included", "Excluded")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
      haz_alc = case_when(
      audit_c_score >= 4 & str_to_lower(gender) == "male" ~ "Hazardous (AUDIT-C)",
      audit_c_score >= 3 & str_to_lower(gender) != "male" ~ "Hazardous (AUDIT-C)",
      is.na(audit_c_score) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ "Not hazardous"
    ),
    obesity = case_when(
      is.na(bmi) ~ NA_character_,
      bmi >= 30 ~ "Obese (BMI ≥ 30)",
      bmi < 30 ~ "Not obese (BMI < 30)"
    ),
    aboriginal = if_else(
      aboriginal == "Indigenous", 1, 0
      )
  )

#Change names of studies
df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    study = case_when(
      study == "Simplify" ~ "SIMPLIFY",
      study == "Defeat" ~ "D3FEAT",
      study == "LiverLife" ~ "LIVERLIFE",
      study == "ETHOS" ~ "ETHOS Engage",
      study == "DARLO" ~ "DARLO-C",
      study == "POCT" ~ "Australian PoC Testing Program",
      study == "TEMPO-RCT" ~ "TEMPO",
      TRUE ~ study
    )
  )

#Total number of cases
df_all %>% count(study)

#Create inclusion/exclusion datasets
df_final <- df_all %>%
  filter(included)

df_excluded <- df_all %>%
  filter(!included)

#Sanity checks
df_all %>%
  count(cohort) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  print()

df_final %>%
  count(cirrhosis = fsm >= 12.5) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  print()

df_final %>%
  count(hcv)

df_final %>%
  count(fibro_valid)

df_all %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  count(hcv)

df_all %>%
  filter(hcv == 1) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  count(is.na(fsm))

df_all %>%
  filter(hcv == 1) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  count(fibro_valid)

# Age-stratified prevalence (included cohort)

# Use the *included analytic cohort* (df_final) so denominators match Table 1
stopifnot(exists("df_final"))

age_bin_prev <- df_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(fsm)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 35, 40, 45, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<35", "35-39", "40-44", "45+")
    ),
    fsm_12_5 = fsm >= 12.5,
    fsm_20 = fsm > 20
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cohort = n(),
    n_fsm_12_5 = sum(fsm_12_5),
    prev_fsm_12_5 = mean(fsm_12_5),
    n_fsm_20 = sum(fsm_20),
    prev_fsm_20 = mean(fsm_20),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

age_bin_prev

write_csv(age_bin_prev, "Results/Descriptives/Cohort_Prevalence_byAgeBin_included.csv")

cat(
  "Included cohort with non-missing age+FSM:",
  sum(age_bin_prev$n_cohort),
  "\n"
)
```

# Summary study level

```{r}
df_study <- read_csv("Data/study_data.csv")

# unweighted table = number of studies
tbl_studies <- df_study %>%
  select(
    `Study location` = study_location,
    `Study design` = study_design,
    `Included sample size` = sample_group,
    `Population included` = population_group
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    missing = "no",
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0),
    sort = list(
      `Study location` ~ "frequency",
      `Study design` ~ "frequency",
      `Included sample size` ~ "frequency",
      `Population included` ~ "frequency"
    )
  )

tbl_studies

```

# Summary Patient level

```{r}
# Print Summary by study
tbl.1 <- df_final %>% 
  select(-id) %>% 
  select(
    Study = study,
    Age = age,
    Gender = gender,
    #Ethnicity = ethnicity,
    `Identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander` = aboriginal,
    #Height = height,
    #Weight = weight,
    `BMI, median (IQR)` = bmi,
    `Obesity (BMI ≥ 30)` = obesity,
    #`Alcohol frequency` = alcohol_frequency_cat,
    #`Alcohol amount` = alcohol_amount_cat,
    #`Alcohol binge frequency` = alcohol_binge_cat,
    `AUDIT-C score` = audit_c_score,
    `Hazardous alcohol use` = haz_alc,
    HIV = hiv,
    HBV = hbv,
    `Median liver stiffness (kPa)` = fsm,
    `Liver stiffness measurement (Metavir category)` = metavir,
    `CSPH (>20 kPa)` = fsm_20
    #`FIB-4 score` = fib4,
    #`FIB-4 category` = fib4_cat,
    #`APRI score` = apri,
    #`APRI category` = apri_cat,
    #ALT = alt,
    #AST = ast,
    #Platelets = platelets,
    #Albumin = albumin,
    #Creatinine = creatinine
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Study,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 0,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0)
    ),
    sort = list(
      `Gender` ~ "frequency",
      `Liver stiffness measurement (Metavir category)` ~ "frequency"),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("stat_"), ~ str_replace_all(., "NA \\(NA, NA\\)", "NA") %>% str_replace_all("0 \\(NA%\\)", "NA")))
  )   %>%
  modify_footnote(
    everything() ~
  "Abbreviations: AUDIT-C = Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test-Consumption; BMI = body mass index; CSPH = clinically significant portal hypertension; HBV = hepatitis B virus; HCV = hepatitis C virus; HIV = human immunodeficiency virus; kPa = kilopascals; NA = not available. Data are presented as median (Q1, Q3) or n (%).")
```

# Included vs excluded

```{r}
tbl.included_vs_excluded <- df_all %>%
  filter(hcv == 1) %>%
  mutate(invalid_fibroscan = if_else(fibro_valid == 0, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Included", "Excluded"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cohort,
    Study = study,
    `Invalid Fibroscan` = invalid_fibroscan,
    `Age, median (IQR)` = age,
    Gender = gender,
    #Ethnicity = ethnicity,
    Aboriginal = aboriginal,
    BMI = bmi,
    `Obesity (BMI ≥ 30)` = obesity,
    `AUDIT-C score` = audit_c_score,
    `Hazardous alcohol use` = haz_alc,
    HIV = hiv,
    HBV = hbv,
    `Median liver stiffness (kPa)` = fsm,
    `Liver stiffness measurement (Metavir category)` = metavir,
    `CSPH (>20 kPa)` = fsm_20
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Cohort,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 0,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0),
      `Median liver stiffness (kPa)` ~ 1
    ),
   sort = list(
      `Gender` ~ "frequency",
      `Liver stiffness measurement (Metavir category)` ~ "frequency"),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("stat_"), ~ str_replace_all(., "NA \\(NA, NA\\)", "NA") %>% str_replace_all("0 \\(NA%\\)", "NA"))) %>%
      mutate(label = if_else(label == "Unknown", "Missing", label))
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_footnote(
    everything() ~ "Abbreviations: AUDIT-C = Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test-Consumption; BMI = body mass index; CSPH = clinically significant portal hypertension; HBV = hepatitis B virus; HCV = hepatitis C virus; HIV = human immunodeficiency virus; kPa = kilopascals; NA = not available. Data are presented as median (Q1, Q3) or n (%)."
  )

tbl.included_vs_excluded 

save_docx(
  tables = list(gtsummary::as_flex_table(tbl.included_vs_excluded)),
  filename = "Results/Descriptives/Table_included_vs_excluded_integer.docx"
)
```
